versions.changelog:
Initial release of aisa-perplexity-search-sonar.

- Enables web, multi-source, and last-30-days research via AIsa.
- Supports search, synthesis, competitor analysis, and trend discovery.
- Provides structured, research-ready outputs suitable for briefs.
- Requires AISA_API_KEY for API access.
- Compatible with OpenClaw, Claude-Code, and Hermes environments.
